import Asset
import Bundle

## The names a build gave the files a page loads, read from its assets.json,
## and the folders those files are in. Written by ./joy: do not edit.
##
## A server reads assets.json when it starts, from the file JOY_ASSETS_JSON
## names or from the output directory its binary is in, and passes the text
## to [parse]. A server that would serve another build's files, or miss a
## bundle, stops there and says why, instead of failing in a browser.
Names := {
	roots : List((Str, Str)),
	joy : Str,
	runtime : Str,
	bundles : List((Str, Str)),
	assets : List((Str, Str)),
	public : List(Str),
}.{

	## Why assets.json was refused.
	Problem : [NotAssetsJson(Str), NoWasm(Str), AssetsDiffer(Str)]

	## Read assets.json, given its text and the folder it is in. Refuses one
	## without a wasm for a bundle of `Bundle.all`, or whose assets have other
	## names than the ones this program was compiled with.
	parse : Str, Str -> Try(Names, Problem)
	parse = |text, folder| {
		value =
			match read_value(Str.to_utf8(text)) {
				Ok((found, _)) => found
				Err(_) => return Err(NotAssetsJson("it is not JSON"))
			}
		roots = fields(value, "roots").keep_oks(|(name, path)| text_of(path).map_ok(|dir| (name, "${folder}/${dir}")))
		joy = text_of(field(value, "joy")) ? |_| NotAssetsJson("it has no joy")
		runtime = text_of(field(value, "runtime")) ?? "runtime.js"
		bundles = fields(value, "bundles").keep_oks(|(id, path)| text_of(path).map_ok(|file| (id, file)))
		assets = fields(value, "assets").keep_oks(|(name, path)| text_of(path).map_ok(|file| (name, file)))
		public =
			match field(value, "public") {
				Items(items) => items.keep_oks(text_of)
				_ => []
			}
		for bundle in Bundle.all {
			if !bundles.any(|(id, _)| id == Bundle.path(bundle)) {
				return Err(NoWasm(Bundle.path(bundle)))
			}
		}
		for (name, path) in Asset.all {
			if !assets.contains((name, path)) {
				return Err(AssetsDiffer(name))
			}
		}
		Ok({ roots, joy, runtime, bundles, assets, public })
	}

	## The loader's path below the client URL.
	joy : Names -> Str
	joy = |names| names.joy

	## The runtime the loader imports, as a path below the client URL.
	runtime : Names -> Str
	runtime = |names| names.runtime

	## The URLs of Joy's files, the way joy-html's `Html.document` takes them:
	## the loader's, the runtime's and each bundle's wasm by the bundle's id.
	joy_files : Names -> { loader : Str, runtime : Str, wasm : Str -> Str }
	joy_files = |names| {
		loader: Str.concat(client_url, names.joy),
		runtime: Str.concat(client_url, names.runtime),
		wasm: |id|
			match names.bundles.find_first(|(bundle, _)| bundle == id) {
				Ok((_, file)) => Str.concat(client_url, file)
				Err(_) => "${client_url}${id}/app.wasm"
			},
	}

	## A bundle's wasm, as a path below the client URL.
	wasm : Names, Bundle -> Str
	wasm = |names, bundle|
		match names.bundles.find_first(|(id, _)| id == Bundle.path(bundle)) {
			Ok((_, file)) => file
			Err(_) => "${Bundle.path(bundle)}/app.wasm"
		}

	## The folders the files are in, to declare as a server's file roots:
	## `joy` for the loader, the runtime and the bundles, `assets` and
	## `public`. In a build all three are the same folder.
	roots : Names -> List({ name : Str, folder : Str })
	roots = |names| names.roots.map(|(name, folder)| { name, folder })

	## Where a path below the client URL is, and how long a cache may keep
	## it: a file with a hash in its name for good, anything else until it
	## has asked again.
	file : Names, Str -> [Found({ root : Str, path : Str, cache : [Immutable, Revalidate] }), NotFound]
	file = |names, path| {
		hashed = |plain| if (plain == path) Revalidate else Immutable
		if path == names.joy {
			Found({ root: "joy", path, cache: hashed("joy.js") })
		} else if path == names.runtime or path == "runtime.js" {
			Found({ root: "joy", path, cache: hashed("runtime.js") })
		} else if names.bundles.any(|(_, file)| file == path) {
			Found({ root: "joy", path, cache: if (path.ends_with("/app.wasm")) Revalidate else Immutable })
		} else {
			match names.assets.find_first(|(_, file)| file == path) {
				Ok((name, _)) => Found({ root: "assets", path, cache: hashed(name) })
				Err(_) => if (names.public.contains(path)) Found({ root: "public", path, cache: Revalidate }) else NotFound
			}
		}
	}
}

## Where the app serves the files, JOY_CLIENT_URL, which ./joy writes here.
client_url : Str
client_url = "/"

# Just enough JSON for assets.json: objects, arrays and strings.

Value := [Text(Str), Items(List(Value)), Fields(List((Str, Value))), Other]

field : Value, Str -> Value
field = |value, key|
	match value {
		Fields(pairs) =>
			match pairs.find_first(|(name, _)| name == key) {
				Ok((_, found)) => found
				Err(_) => Other
			}
		_ => Other
	}

fields : Value, Str -> List((Str, Value))
fields = |value, key|
	match field(value, key) {
		Fields(pairs) => pairs
		_ => []
	}

text_of : Value -> Try(Str, [NotText])
text_of = |value|
	match value {
		Text(text) => Ok(text)
		_ => Err(NotText)
	}

read_value : List(U8) -> Try((Value, List(U8)), [Bad])
read_value = |input|
	match skip_space(input) {
		['"', .. as rest] => read_text(rest, []).map_ok(|(text, after)| (Text(text), after))
		['[', .. as rest] => read_items(skip_space(rest), [])
		['{', .. as rest] => read_fields(skip_space(rest), [])
		_ => Err(Bad)
	}

read_items : List(U8), List(Value) -> Try((Value, List(U8)), [Bad])
read_items = |input, items|
	match input {
		[']', .. as rest] => Ok((Items(items), rest))
		_ => {
			(item, after) = read_value(input)?
			match skip_space(after) {
				[',', .. as rest] => read_items(skip_space(rest), items.append(item))
				[']', .. as rest] => Ok((Items(items.append(item)), rest))
				_ => Err(Bad)
			}
		}
	}

read_fields : List(U8), List((Str, Value)) -> Try((Value, List(U8)), [Bad])
read_fields = |input, pairs|
	match input {
		['}', .. as rest] => Ok((Fields(pairs), rest))
		['"', .. as rest] => {
			(key, after_key) = read_text(rest, [])?
			match skip_space(after_key) {
				[':', .. as after_colon] => {
					(value, after) = read_value(after_colon)?
					match skip_space(after) {
						[',', .. as more] => read_fields(skip_space(more), pairs.append((key, value)))
						['}', .. as more] => Ok((Fields(pairs.append((key, value))), more))
						_ => Err(Bad)
					}
				}
				_ => Err(Bad)
			}
		}
		_ => Err(Bad)
	}

read_text : List(U8), List(U8) -> Try((Str, List(U8)), [Bad])
read_text = |input, bytes|
	match input {
		['"', .. as rest] =>
			match Str.from_utf8(bytes) {
				Ok(text) => Ok((text, rest))
				Err(_) => Err(Bad)
			}
		['\\', escaped, .. as rest] =>
			match escaped {
				'n' => read_text(rest, bytes.append('\n'))
				't' => read_text(rest, bytes.append('\t'))
				'r' => read_text(rest, bytes.append('\r'))
				'u' => read_unicode(rest, bytes)
				other => read_text(rest, bytes.append(other))
			}
		[byte, .. as rest] => read_text(rest, bytes.append(byte))
		[] => Err(Bad)
	}

## `\uXXXX`, written out as UTF-8.
read_unicode : List(U8), List(U8) -> Try((Str, List(U8)), [Bad])
read_unicode = |input, bytes|
	match input {
		[a, b, c, d, .. as rest] => {
			code : U32
			code = [a, b, c, d].fold_try(0, |sum, digit| hex_digit(digit).map_ok(|value| sum * 16 + value))?
			encoded =
				if code < 0x80 {
					[code.to_u8_wrap()]
				} else if code < 0x800 {
					[(0xC0 + code // 64).to_u8_wrap(), (0x80 + code % 64).to_u8_wrap()]
				} else {
					[(0xE0 + code // 4096).to_u8_wrap(), (0x80 + (code // 64) % 64).to_u8_wrap(), (0x80 + code % 64).to_u8_wrap()]
				}
			read_text(rest, bytes.concat(encoded))
		}
		_ => Err(Bad)
	}

hex_digit : U8 -> Try(U32, [Bad])
hex_digit = |digit|
	if digit >= '0' and digit <= '9' {
		Ok((digit - '0').to_u32())
	} else if digit >= 'a' and digit <= 'f' {
		Ok((digit - 'a' + 10).to_u32())
	} else if digit >= 'A' and digit <= 'F' {
		Ok((digit - 'A' + 10).to_u32())
	} else {
		Err(Bad)
	}

skip_space : List(U8) -> List(U8)
skip_space = |input|
	match input {
		[' ', .. as rest] | ['\n', .. as rest] | ['\r', .. as rest] | ['\t', .. as rest] => skip_space(rest)
		_ => input
	}
